description: VR mod for Rolling Quest (itch.io): play it in a SteamVR headset, behind the ball or as a tabletop diorama.
notes: Rolling Quest VR is installed into your Rolling Quest folder (found automatically, or picked by you).
It adds 'Rolling Quest VR' to Steam and SteamVR's library (Non-Steam) after Steam next restarts. The first start takes a minute or two.
Upgrading from 1.0.0: the old launcher, scripts and desktop shortcut are removed; the Steam entry now starts the game directly.
Game moved? Set the ROLLINGQUEST_DIR environment variable to its folder and install again.

script: # Game folder: ROLLINGQUEST_DIR, the folder used last time, or the installer's own search; if that fails, ask.
$pick = (New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).BrowseForFolder(0, 'Rolling Quest VR: select your Rolling Quest folder (the one with RollingQuest.exe)', 0x51, 17)

if (-not $pick -or -not (Test-Path "$($pick.Self.Path)\RollingQuest.exe")) { throw 'Rolling Quest not found. Set the ROLLINGQUEST_DIR environment variable to the folder with RollingQuest.exe and install again.' }
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'Rolling Quest VR setup failed (see the log above).' }
if (-not $gd) { $m = $log | Select-String '^Installing Rolling Quest VR \S+ into (.+)$' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($m) { $gd = $m.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value.Trim() } }
# On update the new version's installer simply installs over the old one; only a real uninstall removes the mod.
